text:
Nikhil Rao: opening RidgeView POC perf thread — customer target = sustained 360 qps (short turns) with ~12% embeds and some 2k+ token threads. goal p95 <200ms. need fp16, ptq-int8, awq-int8 runs + one mixed embed soak. who can own infra + corpus?
Sam Torres: I can run in dedicated us-west3. ask RidgeView for a 1k-session sample with labelled embeds; if they don't provide we'll synth 12% embed calls. enable prefix caching for warm runs?
Helena Voss: yes enable prefix caching. test plan: 4m ramp, 22m steady, 6m soak (embed-mix), 4m cooldown. capture p50/p95/p99, cold tails, kv-cache hit, GPU mem and token throughput. will do cold+warm variants.
sre-bot: provisioning cluster/dedicated/us-west3/slotset-11 image=redwood-runtime:2026-05-01-rc status=queued.
Nikhil Rao: security request: RidgeView asked for HSM-backed KMS + proof of key zeroing on teardown. please include a short security appendix and contact.
security-team: we can confirm HSM option for Private and Dedicated, and key zeroing on teardown is documented. we'll draft the appendix and attach SOC2 reference.
Sam Torres: infra sizing rec: 10 active slots + 2 spare for headroom (approx 10-12% headroom). multi-az failover doubles infra and impacts pricing/SLA — flag that to the customer.
Helena Voss: pre-run estimates: fp16 p95 ~190ms, ptq-int8 p95 ~220-240ms jitter, awq-int8 p95 ~170-185ms but watch p99 spikes on cold. GPU util est: fp16 62%, ptq 47%, awq 36%. cost ratios: ptq ~0.6x, awq ~0.5x. will compute $/1M tokens post-run.
Nikhil Rao: quality gate: 60-case eval focused on long-context coherence. flag any >4% accuracy regression or >2% hallucination increase vs fp16. propose canary-to-fp16 for sessions >1.5k tokens.
Sam Torres: running fp16 baseline now. command: 
```
loadtest --corpus s3://redwood-poc/ridgeview/1k.json --target 360 --ramp 4m --steady 22m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant fp16 --cache-prefix --output /artifacts/ridgeview/4275002468/fp16.csv
```
sre-bot: run complete -> /artifacts/ridgeview/4275002468/fp16.csv status=success
Helena Voss: fp16 smoke: p95=188ms, p99=415ms (cold tails), kv-hit=70%, GPU util avg=61%. exporting CSV.
Sam Torres: ptq run in progress.
sre-bot: ptq run complete -> /artifacts/ridgeview/4275002468/ptq.csv status=success
Helena Voss: ptq results: p95=228ms, p99=520ms, jitter visible on steady-state, kv-hit=66%, GPU util=46%.
sre-bot: awq run complete -> /artifacts/ridgeview/4275002468/awq.csv status=success
Helena Voss: awq summary: p95=174ms, p99=490ms with occasional spikes to 650ms on first decode of long contexts. kv-hit=75%, GPU util=35%. eval (60-case): 2 cases >4% accuracy drop, hallucination delta +1.2%.
Nikhil Rao: great. can someone assemble a one-pager PDF with bullets, heatmaps, CSVs, cost per 1M tokens for each quant, the 60-case eval diff, and the security appendix? target EOD. I'll include recommendation: awq-int8 + prefix caching + canary-to-fp16 for >1.5k sessions. :thumbsup:
